title: Length of Last Word
summary: Given a string s made up of words and spaces, return the length of the final word in the string.
statement: Given a string s made up of words and spaces, return the length of the final word in the string. A word is defined as the longest substring of non-space characters.
constraints: s contains English letters and spaces, with at least one word.
hints: Trailing spaces do not belong to any word.
Scan backward past trailing spaces, then count letters until the next space or the start.
Remember the last non-space index, move left over its word, and subtract the boundary indices.
The source guarantees a word exists, so the trailing-space scan will reach a letter.
editorial: Move a pointer left from the end until it reaches a non-space character. Save that endpoint, then continue left while characters are not spaces. The difference between the endpoint and the stopping index is the final word's length. This avoids splitting the entire string into a new list.

tests.explanation: The final word is World, which has five letters.
Ignore trailing spaces; moon is the final word and has length four.
